violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Water damage occurring to particle board cabinet/drawers at 3 tub sink system.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Store boxes of single use tissues/towels off floor in back storage room.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 140F or above during display or service. Soup crock not maintaining chili at proper temperature. (115 degrees F.)

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -floors in and around the coolers and under the floor matts in work area need cleaning.
